definitions.full: H7510. rippayon [ רִמָּיוֺן Ges § 85u , or רִפְיוֺן Sta § 296d compare Kö ii. 154 ] noun [masculine] sinking ; — construct יָדַיִם רִפְיוֺן Jer 47:3 sinking of hands , figurative of helpless terror.
